purpose: Review a finite issuer pension, post-employment-benefit, actuarial-funding and termination-benefit disclosure domain before opening source rows, filing text, obligation or plan-asset values, candidate values, comparators, security prices or returns.

repository_evidence.human_capital_boundary: Campaign164 freezes headcount, employee mix, compensation and productivity disclosures. Workforce scale or payroll does not establish a defined-benefit obligation, plan asset, actuarial assumption, funding deficit, contribution schedule, benefit payment or settlement.
repository_evidence.debt_and_lease_boundary: Borrowing maturities and lease liabilities concern creditor or use-right contracts. Pension and post-employment obligations require beneficiary, plan, trustee, service, vesting, actuarial and plan-asset identities that cannot be inferred from debt or lease balances.
repository_evidence.insurance_boundary: Campaign172 freezes enterprise policy coverage and claim-risk transfer. Insured employee benefits or annuity contracts may be plan assets, but an insurance mention does not establish employer benefit obligation, funded status, entitlement or actuarial remeasurement.
repository_evidence.tax_boundary: Campaign173 freezes enterprise tax-position and compliance states. Deductibility, payroll tax or social contribution treatment does not establish the amount, timing or funding status of an employee benefit obligation.
repository_evidence.market_risk_boundary: A discount rate or asset return assumption is an actuarial input, not a security-market hedge signal; neither market-price paths nor interest-rate exposure can substitute for plan-specific obligation and asset histories.
repository_evidence.point_in_time_boundary: A current annual-report employee-benefit note cannot be projected backward without plan identity, beneficiary and service history, amendment, curtailment, settlement, contribution, payment, remeasurement, correction and first-public histories.

must_freeze_before_any_formula_or_direct: exact issuer filing, exchange announcement, statutory social-insurance registry, trustee, fund or licensed structured source with immutable bytes and stable observation identity
first-public timestamp, trading-session availability, reporting measurement date, plan inception, amendment, freeze, curtailment, settlement, termination, correction and supersession chain
issuer, listed security, parent, subsidiary, branch, employee group, beneficiary class, trustee, custodian, insurer and plan mapping without current-state leakage

benefit taxonomy separating defined benefit, defined contribution, mandatory social insurance, housing fund, enterprise annuity, post-employment medical, long-service, termination, severance and early-retirement arrangements
plan rules covering service attribution, vesting, retirement age, benefit formula, salary base, indexation, employee contribution, employer contribution and portability
defined-benefit obligation, fair value of plan assets, funded status, asset ceiling, unrecognized state, service cost, net interest, actuarial gain or loss and other-comprehensive-income identity
plan-asset class, valuation date, fair value hierarchy, related-party asset, expected or actual return, liquidity and asset-liability matching semantics
discount rate, salary growth, mortality, turnover, medical-cost trend, retirement-age and sensitivity assumptions with unit, horizon, scenario and revision semantics
employer contribution, arrears, funding schedule, benefit payment, reimbursement right, settlement, curtailment, plan amendment and cash-timing identity
currency, unit, consolidation scope, gross-versus-net presentation, restatement and accounting-standard transition semantics
missing, undisclosed, not-applicable, state-funded, insured, settled, terminated, true zero obligation, zero plan asset, zero contribution and zero payment semantics without favorable absence coding

complete bounded 2019-2023 partition manifest, full-market denominator, issuer and plan identifier history, delisting coverage, pagination and parser, identity, timing, unit, actuarial-rollforward and source-acceptance tests using no candidate, comparator, security-price or return values

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: defined_benefit_obligation_plan_asset_and_funded_status_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer funded or unfunded defined-benefit position linking the present value of obligations, fair-value plan assets, asset ceiling and reimbursement rights.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No accepted point-in-time history freezes plan and beneficiary identity, obligation and asset rollforwards, valuation date, consolidation scope, currency, asset ceiling, reimbursement right, corrections and first availability across the full 2019-2023 issuer universe.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: actuarial_assumption_remeasurement_service_cost_and_settlement_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer transition in actuarial assumptions, service cost, net interest, remeasurement, curtailment or settlement of post-employment obligations.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: The repository lacks a complete history linking discount, salary, mortality, turnover and medical assumptions to plan-specific service periods, amendments, experience adjustments, settlements, OCI or profit-and-loss presentation and public timing.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: defined_contribution_social_insurance_annuity_funding_and_arrears_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer employer-contribution, statutory social-insurance, housing-fund or enterprise-annuity funding state including scheduled cash, arrears and remediation.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Expense lines do not identify covered employees, jurisdictional rate, contribution base, due date, arrears, waiver, remediation, plan transfer, cash payment, subsidiary scope or first-public history in one complete cross-issuer contract.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: termination_severance_early_retirement_and_post_employment_medical_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer obligation and settlement state for involuntary termination, voluntary severance, early retirement, long-service or post-employment medical benefits.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted source links employee group, offer and acceptance dates, service and vesting conditions, restructuring identity, benefit formula, medical trend, payment schedule, reversal, settlement, correction and trading-session availability.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: headcount_payroll_employee_expense_debt_lease_or_security_price_relabeling
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: An existing workforce, payroll, accounting expense, leverage, lease, interest-rate or security-price state relabeled as a pension or post-employment-benefit state.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Headcount, payroll, employee-benefit expense, debt, lease liability, interest-rate exposure or price path does not identify a plan, beneficiary, obligation, plan asset, contribution, actuarial assumption, curtailment or settlement; renaming it would not create a new primitive.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: pension_burden_funded_status_assumption_contribution_direction_scale_or_window_variant
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A transform of obligation, funded status, plan asset, contribution, expense, actuarial change or benefit payment against assets, revenue, payroll, cash flow, debt, employees or time.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Choosing higher or lower funded status, discount-rate sensitivity, contribution adequacy, denominator, peer residual, employee subset, plan type or event window before source admission would multiply hypotheses; larger obligations can reflect mature benefits, legacy burden or retention investment.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: combined_funded_status_actuarial_funding_and_termination_score_or_model
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: Joint issuer post-employment-benefit state across obligations, plan assets, actuarial changes, contributions and termination or medical benefits.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Combining four unadmitted heterogeneous source families or selecting weights, ranks, interactions, filters or models would expand the search before any component has a complete point-in-time source contract.

scientific_interpretation.safe_conclusion: Four distinct pension and post-employment-benefit states remain deferred at source admission; workforce, accounting, debt, lease, market or security-price relabeling, premature operator search and unadmitted combinations are closed before values.
